$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Secret Manager. One entry per console section; level per substrate (nano = shared core, also dev_server/unified ingress; offline = appliance). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py — a claim the backend does not honour fails CI.

gcp.secret-manager.version.crud.title: Versions (add, list, access, enable, disable, destroy)

gcp.secret-manager.replication.title: Replication policy (locations) and encryption (CMEK)
limitations: The replication policy is validated the way the real API validates it (exactly one of automatic/userManaged, non-empty/unique userManaged locations, a well-formed CMEK key name whose location matches its replica) and is immutable after creation, but Vyomi keeps one copy of the payload — it does not physically replicate it across locations or encrypt it with the named Cloud KMS key.

gcp.secret-manager.rotation.title: Rotation
limitations: Rotation is validated the way the real API validates it (a rotation period/nextRotationTime requires at least one configured Pub/Sub topic, a minimum 1-hour period, a future nextRotationTime), and removing the last topic while a rotation policy is active is rejected. Vyomi still does not run a rotation schedule or add versions automatically.

gcp.secret-manager.notifications.title: Notifications (Pub/Sub topics)
limitations: Vyomi publishes a real Pub/Sub message to every configured topic on SECRET_VERSION_ADD/ENABLE/DISABLE/DESTROY (and on auto-expiry); it does not publish SECRET_ROTATE, since rotation itself isn't run on a schedule.

gcp.secret-manager.permissions.title: Permissions (IAM policy)
limitations: getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy/testIamPermissions store a real per-secret policy that IS enforced (versions.access/add/enable/disable/destroy and secrets.update/delete/setIamPolicy are denied for a principal the policy doesn't grant); it covers a curated set of predefined roles and a single X-Cloudlearn-Principal header rather than Google's full role catalog and credential model.

gcp.secret-manager.logs.title: Logs
limitations: Secret create/version-add/enable/disable/destroy/delete/setIamPolicy/auto-expire events write a real Cloud Logging entry the Logs tab reads back (entries:list); read/access calls and the full Cloud Audit Log protoPayload shape aren't recorded.

gcp.secret-manager.regional-secrets.title: Regional secrets
limitations: Regional secrets (projects/{p}/locations/{location}/secrets/...) are a distinct resource namespace from global secrets, with their own create/get/list/delete, version lifecycle (addVersion/access/enable/disable/destroy), labels/annotations/rotation/expiration/notifications/versionAliases and an enforced per-secret IAM policy — but Vyomi keeps one copy of the payload in the named location rather than running Google's dedicated regional infrastructure, and a customerManagedEncryption key is validated (shape + location match, immutable after creation) without being used to actually encrypt anything.
